summary: Intercorp Financial Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K to disclose the appointment of EY Perú as its external auditor for 2026 via an Engagement Letter dated June 12, 2026, under a master agreement from 2022. No financial terms, board recommendations, advisory roles, or transaction mechanics are involved. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure required by SEC rules for foreign private issuers. It does not constitute a special situation such as M&A, capital returns, or restructuring. There are no terms to track or risk-arb angle; simply a standard auditor retention announcement.
